What Happened

  • The party woke up at the Sturdy Mugg on Day 2
  • Over breakfast, they overheard another adventuring group — the Nightstalkers — loudly discussing plans to clear goblins from the mines
  • Oren Hammerfist noticed the party eavesdropping and rushed off ahead to handle the mines first

Key Takeaways

  • Another experienced party is also working jobs in Highreach — potential rivals or allies
  • The mines quest is competitive — others may beat the party to the punch
